overview_description.description: TON is a global, decentralized blockchain community dedicated to putting cryptocurrency into everyone's pockets. TON's aim is to empower 500 million users to own their digital identity, data, and assets by 2028 by establishing the Web3 ecosystem via Telegram Messenger. TON is a decentralized blockchain platform designed for fast, secure, and scalable transactions. Originally developed by Telegram, it supports smart contracts, decentralized applications, and digital payments. TON aims to provide high-speed processing with low fees, making it suitable for everyday use. Its ecosystem includes wallets, services, and apps that enable users to interact with blockchain technology easily and efficiently.

about_short_description.short_description: TON is a global, decentralized blockchain community dedicated to putting cryptocurrency into everyone's pockets.

product.name: TON Blockchain
product.description: A decentralized, scalable blockchain network for cryptocurrency transactions, smart contracts, digital assets, and Web3 applications.

product.name: Gram
product.description: The native cryptocurrency of the TON blockchain, used for transaction fees, staking and validation, network governance, and payments.

product.name: TON Blockchain Primitives
product.description: Core TON capabilities for issuing tokens and NFTs, transferring assets, sponsoring fees, staking, using stablecoins, and sending blockchain messages.

product.name: TON Connect
product.description: A wallet-connection protocol that lets users authenticate with and approve transactions from TON wallets in decentralized applications and Mini Apps.

product.name: TON Decentralized Internet Protocols
product.description: A group of protocols for decentralized storage, file sharing, domain names, private networking, payments, and private AI computing.

product.name: TON Developer Toolset
product.description: Open-source tools, SDKs, APIs, languages, testing utilities, and deployment workflows for building TON smart contracts, dApps, Mini Apps, and wallet integrations.
